chapters.reason: The paper's core contribution is a router that dynamically selects between a stronger and a weaker LLM to optimize cost and performance, which is the definition of Model Switch.
The paper focuses on the practical deployment of LLMs in real-world systems where cost-effective query routing is a critical application-layer optimization.
The paper introduces a framework for evaluating the trade-off between cost and response quality, contributing to the measurement of reasoning efficiency.
